# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in any Nebulas X service or repository, write to
**security@nebulas-x.com**. Please do not open a public issue, pull request or discussion.

Include what you can:
- the affected service, URL or component;
- the steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect;
- any proof of concept, kept to the minimum needed to show the problem.

Please do not access, change or delete data that is not yours, degrade the service, or use social engineering or
physical attacks. Test only against your own account and data.

## What happens next

We acknowledge your report, keep you informed while we investigate and fix the problem, and tell you when it is
resolved. We ask that you keep the details private until a fix is available.
